entries.reason: iOS 6 does not export the name; it is carried as the identifier of iOS 8 for SVG images, which the type database of the release may not declare
entries.effect: the constant is the string public.svg-image
entries.source: CoreImage and MobileCoreServices of the arm64 shared cache of iOS 12.0, the constant strings; an iPad 2 and the iOS 6.0 emulator for the exports of the release

entries.reason: rank 29 of the frameworks demand table, LOAD-FAIL for provenance and yattee; a dynamic identifier is a spelling ("dyn." and an encoded tail), which 6.1.3 already makes for tags it has no type for
entries.effect: true for "dyn." in any case followed by dot-separated components of ASCII letters, digits and inner hyphens, false for anything else and for NULL
entries.source: the host's CoreServices, which the port is held against by tests/backports/host/uttype; an iPad 2 on 6.1.3; the armv7 cache ladder, which first exports the function at 8.0
